title: 電気回路Ⅱ
subtitle: Electric Circuit II
teachers:
ITO Kouhei
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
(1) Acquire the ability to mathematically formulate various phenomena in electric circuits.
(2) Solve first-order differential equations to perform DC transient analysis.
(3) Use complex numbers to analyze AC circuits.
advice:
This is a fundamental course in electric circuits. We will mainly cover the following topics:
1. Expressing transient phenomena in electric circuits consisting of DC power supplies, resistors, capacitors, and inductors in differential equations
2. Solving first-order differential equations in electric circuits consisting of DC power supplies, resistors, capacitors, and inductors
3. Using complex numbers to analyze electric circuits consisting of AC power supplies, resistors, capacitors, and inductors

Students are expected to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to complete exercises independently.
Students are required to be aware of the instructor's messages in the class and to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class because the course schedule may change depending on the class progress.
books: Introduction to Electric Circuits and Systems (in Japanese)
requiredKnowledge:
Completion of ``Electric Circuit I.''
Sufficient mathematical calculation skills (especially polynomial and fractional expressions).
Basic knowledge of differential calculus.

activityGoals.body: Express transient phenomena with differential equations.
Express relationships among voltage, current, and electric power in DC circuits.
Express relationships among voltage, current, and electric power in AC circuits.
Calculate voltage, current, and electric power in AC circuits using complex numbers.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Use differential equations to express transient phenomena in electric circuits consisting of DC power supplies, resistors, capacitors, and inductors.
(2) Solve first-order differential equations for electric circuits consisting of DC power supplies, resistors, capacitors, and inductors.
(3) Use complex numbers to analyze AC circuits.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Use differential equations to express transient phenomena in relatively simple electric circuits consisting of DC power supplies, resistors, capacitors, and inductors.
(2) Solve first-order differential equations in simple electric circuits consisting of DC power supplies, resistors, capacitors, and inductors.
(3) Use complex numbers to analyze simple AC circuits.
